t: People Who Established Torture Sites in Ukraine Will Be Held Accountable - Russian Envoy
d: MOSCOW, (Sputnik) - Those who established secret torture sites in Ukraine will be held accountable for their grave crimes, regardless of any statute of limitations, Russian MFA Ambassador-at-Large Rodion Miroshnik told Sputnik.

t: Russia, Afghanistan Planning to Sign Intergovernmental Agreement on Trade - Official
d: MOSCOW, November 11 (Sputnik) - Russia and Afghanistan plan to sign a large-scale bilateral agreement on trade and economic cooperation, Rustam Khabibullin, head of the Russian Business Center in Afghanistan, told Sputnik.

t: Israel Approves Delivery of Humanitarian Aid to Gaza Strip to Prepare for Winter - PM Office
d: The Israeli government has approved the delivery of humanitarian aid to the Gaza Strip to prepare the region for the coming winter, the office of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said.

t: West Can Acknowledge Torture Chambers in Ukraine Only Under Pressure - Russian Envoy

t: Russian Delegation Arrives at Abu Dhabi Talks Venue
d: The Russian delegation arrived at the venue of the trilateral talks involving Russia, the United States and Ukraine in Abu Dhabi on the second day, a Sputnik correspondent reports.

t: Second Day of Abu Dhabi Talks Starts
d: The second day of trilateral talks involving delegations from Russia, the United States and Ukraine started in Abu Dhabi on Wednesday, a source in the negotiating group told Sputnik.

t: Russia's Degelation Head Medinsky Briefs Reporters After Trilateral Talks in Abu Dhabi
d: Trilateral talks between Russia, the United States and Ukraine were held in Abu Dhabi, UAE, on November 10-11.

t: Topic of Security Architecture Was Central at Abu Dhabi Talks - Medinsky
d: Following the trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi, Russian Presidential Aide Vladimir Medinsky called the framing of the question of a continental security system after the end of the conflict in Ukraine correct.

t: New US Attacks on Iran Will Have Serious Consequences for Region - Embassy
d: Any new US attacks on Iran will have serious consequences for the entire region, Afshin Parchizadeh, minister-counselor at the Iranian Embassy in Russia, said.

t: China, India, South Korea Planning to Use Northern Sea Route for Regular Trade
d: South Korea, India and China plan to use the Northern Sea Route as a regular shipping corridor, Russian Far East and Arctic Development Minister Alexei Chekunkov said.

t: Putin Calls Dialogue in Narrow CSTO Format Thorough, Productive
d: The dialogue in the narrow format of the Collective Security Treaty Organization (CSTO) is thorough and productive, Russia President Vladimir Putin said on Wednesday.
